---
title: "Using R"
---

This book utilizes [`WebR`](https://docs.r-wasm.org/webr/latest/) to teach analytical components. `WebR` enables an interactive code editor within your viewing browser, so you can write, execute, and recieve feedback on code relevant for your psychometrics project.

```{webr-r}
fit = lm(mpg ~ am, data = mtcars)

summary(fit)
```
